name: Choking Fog

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: You conjure a fog bank so thick that it's nearly impossible to breathe or see. All creatures within the fog become Concealed, and all creatures outside the fog become concealed to creatures within it. All breathing creatures within the fog must hold their breath or begin to suffocate. You can Dismiss the fog.
